rationale: SLICE round 1 for the claw round-3 design (face 12 mm; replaces the round-2 plan). Profiles: stock MK3S printer, 0.20mm QUALITY @MK3 and Prusament PETG from config/printer.json; filament_type PETG = print_requirements, spec 6 and the brief. Temperatures stay in the filament profile (240/250 C nozzle, 85/90 C bed, fan 30-50 %: inside 230-250 / 80-90 and the skill's PETG range); the 12 mm gear has short layers, so the profile's slowdown below 15 s a layer keeps them cooling. No library rows: no flow, temperature or xy compensation overrides. Requirements, checked at the 12 mm face: perimeters 4 (min 4), top/bottom 6 (min 6), fill 100 % rectilinear (min 100, equals rectilinear), layer 0.2 (max 0.2), 1 h limit. At 12 mm the part is 60 layers: 6 bottom (1.2 mm) sit under the pocket ceiling at Z 2.0, 6 top (1.2 mm) over the counterbore floor at Z 8.3 and the face at 12.0, and 100 % makes everything between solid as the brief asks (teeth and horn stubs carry the grip, strength round 3: 3.61). Module-1 teeth are about 4 extrusion widths: 4 perimeters fill them. Elephant-foot 0.2 pairs with the 0.25 mm bed chamfer (tooth outline included) and the 0.2 mm pocket-mouth chamfer; the audit checks the first layer keeps every tooth. Seam: aligned (stock, stated), so seams go to tooth tips or roots, not the flanks; the audit checks. Supports off: the only overhang is the horn pocket's 7.5 mm ceiling at Z 2.0, a bridge anchored all round (brief, mesh_check). No brim: it would fill the tooth gaps. Copies 1 (spec 7), one plate.
